prompt: Write a single, self-contained prompt for a text-to-image model that has never heard of Chinese memes, so that it draws a cat version of the "大笑奶龙" (Laughing Nailong / 奶蛙) meme. Output only the prompt.
answer:
A flat 2D cartoon sticker illustration of an extremely chubby, egg-shaped cat, drawn in a simple bold-outline vector style with no shading gradients. The cat's fur is a pale creamy butter-yellow, with a slightly lighter cream belly and muzzle. Its body is one soft rounded blob — no visible neck — with very short stubby arms flung up and outward in glee, tiny rounded paws with no fingers, and two little stubby feet peeking out at the bottom. On top of its head are two small triangular cat ears, and a short thick tail curls out behind.

The face is the focus and fills most of the head: the cat is caught mid-burst of hysterical laughter, head tipped slightly back. Both eyes are squeezed completely shut into thick upward-curving black crescent arcs (happy "^ ^" arcs), with tiny crinkle lines at the corners. Its mouth is enormously wide open in an exaggerated gaping grin that stretches nearly ear to ear — a big rounded dark shape with a soft pink interior and a small pink tongue at the bottom, and two tiny white kitten fangs poking down from the upper lip. Chubby round cheeks bulge on either side of the mouth, with a small pink blush oval on each. Three simple straight whiskers stick out from each cheek. Optionally two tiny cartoon tear droplets fly off from the outer corners of the shut eyes to signal laughing so hard it cries.

Overall vibe: goofy, derpy, unhinged joy — a dumb-happy reaction-image mascot, not realistic and not elegant. Clean uniform black outlines, flat solid fills, minimal detail, cute chibi proportions, front-facing centered composition, plain pure white background, no text, no letters, no watermark, square image.
